title: DRAG: Data Reconstruction Attack using Guided Diffusion
summary: Printed core guided sampler has positive loss-gradient sign and inconsistent standard-noise/displacement scaling. Pinned code uses negative direction and direct displacement, so historical benchmark failure is not established. DINO descriptor provenance Needs Evidence.
limitations: No attack or author code executed.
No checkpoint tensors, historical metric logs or raw reconstructions audited.
Small sample set limits population claims; no uncertainty reproduced.
External pinned transformers source retrieval failed; model card consulted.

problems.title: Printed guidance sign and noise scaling contradict the core minimization sampler

source_claim.paraphrase: Minimize representation loss using positive loss-gradient direction in guided noise whose radius already includes sigma.

assumptions: Nonzero loss gradient and positive sigma
Literal definitions of Eq3 and Eq8
At w1, positive gradient endpoint; scalar local smooth objective illustrates sign
No hidden sign or redefinition of standardized epsilon
problems.check: Positive guidance has positive inner product with loss gradient. Quadratic local loss increases. Eq8 sets epsilon norm sqrt(n)*sigma; Eq3 then scales it to sqrt(n)*sigma^2. For n4,sigma.1 intendedr.2 but literaldisplacement.02.
problems.result: Printed core step differs in direction and units from minimization guidance and pinned release.
counterevidence: Pinned run_drag_ldm.py313 uses -r*v; diffusion.py91-96 adds supplied displacement directly.
Historical runs may have used this consistent implementation.
problems.core_dependency: Central conditional-guidance operation of proposed method.
problems.impact: Major algorithm-definition error; independent paper implementation changes. Does not disprove reported privacy-risk evidence.

correction.statement: Use negative loss-gradient guidance and one consistent displacement or standardized-noise convention; no repaired run performed.

problems.title: DINO semantic metric may include an uninitialized projection

source_claim.paraphrase: DINO ViT-S/16 image similarity quantifies semantic reconstruction.

assumptions: Pinned code returns pooler_output and removes layernorm
Source comment reports newly initialized pooler dense weights/bias
Historical checkpoint state and outputs not loaded
problems.check: Static extraction path differs from provider model-card last-hidden-CLS usage. Toy nonisometric transform changes cosine .7071 to .9950, demonstrating why arbitrary projection cannot be presumed metric-equivalent.
problems.result: Need actual loaded state/descriptor/seed and intended-feature comparison to determine impact.
counterevidence: Shared fixed projection may retain useful comparisons.
MS-SSIM and LPIPS support independent evidence.
No actual ordering reversal or score error measured.
problems.core_dependency: One of three evaluation metrics and semantic-similarity claims.
problems.impact: Unresolved; no blanket rejection of other metrics or privacy conclusion.

correction.statement: Document actual descriptor/checkpoint/seed and compare intended features on existing reconstructions.
